text: it's charming. The style and mixture of elements doesn't make me feel overwhelmed. after playing a bit, the only issue I really have is the staggered server release. I understand with power level creep, newer players will feel left behind, but now I have a problem where I cannot play with my friend who started later than I did. there is.no transfer system and this game may merge later, but for now we are both playing solo... it doesn't feel good.

I enjoy idle games and this is one of the best I've played. I like the story and the branching of abilities and classes. The power increase becomes very noticeable later with tougher monsters, but that's what you expect from these type of games, but I don't really find it hard to overcome since the game makes it possible to progress. My main issue is that recently the game has been kicking me out alot lately during raids or just while loading, hopefully this gets patched soon

One of the best mobile games I've played in awhile. I'm completely F2P and for the first 20 days I was constantly moving forward in the game. The progression has slowed down a bit, but has not come to a screeching halt like most mobile games. Edit: Changed the rating to 3 starts from 5. the dungeons are full of people who don't heal themselves and waste everyone else's time. They are chasing stupid titles and friendship points and don't care about the outcome of the dungeon.

how is this a game? you don't even control combat and there's only one order to proceed. it's just watching it do it like a simulation of a game. I guess you can pick what you look like, to an extent and pick what skills are used, but there's no strategy at all. it's really greedy too, with tones of purchase options that add no fun to the "game"

I've played quite a few games like this but this one has a quite massive scope. I want to also praise the player to player interactions. A lot of the game is combat level padding but the players can be quite friendly, there’s high quality voice acting, decent player x player content and an expanded guild system. This game is a cut above the other ones in the genre. My gripes are that I don't get to use my ai friends much, there no endless battle mode and the ability pool is somewhat lacking.

Absolutely one of the best games on mobile I've ever played. So why 1 star? it's horrifically pay to win with severe pay walls to continue pve content. I just want to play the game, but you can't unless you spend because they keep releasing dungeons and content for paying players only. you can't even explore without paying once you max out your character, or wait for weeks to gain the f2p power ups. plus, except for exploration the game plays itself while you do nothing except watch. boring.

Pretty fun game. There is a diversity in NPCs, from an adventurous young girl, to a person stuck as a cat, to an alcoholic old guy. And you can talk to them on the phone, lmao. This is my favorite part. It's my first time playing a game like this, but it's easy to understand and get into. You can get to higher levels even without paying. You can make friends, and they can help you access some specific areas you might not be powerful enough to yet. no complaints :D

While the game can be fun with all the stuff you can do, it can be very predatory. It is 100% P2W. Arena, Tournaments, and Guild Clash are always dominated by the biggest wallets. All the best skins are locked behind mileage of spending. Every event that comes out there are "packs" that you can buy to get more than others. Keep these in mind as you play this game. As long as you don't FOMO and be competitive with the top players, you can have a good time.

A lot of potential. However the perpetual adds for the pack "deals", and their absurd savings designations detract from the game. The reward passes are15-20 bucks, and they don't advance you that much further, as such they provide minimal value. Streamlining the daily reward collection system would greatly improve playability. It seems like half of the play time is navigating those menus. The framework for a fantastic game is there, it just needs some polishing.

This game is great. It has room for growth, or it could hit rock bottom, but I can't see that happening any time soon. It might be a bit redundant, considering the name of the game, but I think a bit more diversity with weapon types such as spears, axes, hammers/maces, and daggers, would offer a more versatile and enjoyable experience. Aside from that, have fun when you make changes to the game, since when you have fun, we have fun. Thanks for making this game, and keep it up! 👍

Im changing my review to 1 star. If you feel like clearing new areas in a few minutes then sitting around for 5 days to gain enough xp to advance then this is the game for you. I thought this was going to be fun and have have challenges, turns out its just a big waiting game with very little content to actually keep you playing and having fun. I even spent money to try and get farther and more power. Turns out $100 gets you 1.5k power. When you need another 10k power to move on. No Ty

Game is fine. Cute little idle RPG with decent enough story and relatively consistent progression. It definitely has some server optimization issues however. I experience heavy lag constantly through the game, so bad to the point that the loadout feature is worthless, because I can't load into event battles before it starts so I can't even change my loadout to fit the battle. I have a Samsung A16 that I just upgraded to a couple of months ago, and fiber optic internet with 2GB download speed.

I'm enjoying the game, but I am a bit disappointed that the character creation wasn't as advertised. it said you could upload an image of a character and ai would create a character basoff it, and that wasn't the case. was kinda the reason for downloading the game. also please add something to lower the quality of the game, cus it's fun but with it always set to max, it Matthew game crash a lot.

This game gets a LOT of things right. Biggest is the amount of play you get for free. There's tons of stuff to upgrade and very little hidden by paywalls. Gameplay is a nice mix of AFK, exploration and PVE. The voice acting is good, and even the tone hits, (there are details that are genuinely humorous, like the text conversations with companions). Cute, deep, charming, challenging and generous, this game is actually a really nice little grinder.

seems fun so far. Just came out, so we shall see. worth the time so far. (UPDATE) 6-30-26 i have spent about 60 bucks so far. honestly it is really fun. first mobile I've actually ever spent money on. could do with some life improvement fixes. and if they could make it so you could do a little more each day to progress which is slow. really my only gripe. continues to be entertaining.

The game itself feels pretty ok but the economy is pretty unbalanced. As others have said, it will take weeks of consistent grinding early areas to get map only currency to use items to fully explore stuff. while the game is f2p friendly, it offers heavy pay to progress options and hides things that western markets don't like. eg, cosmetic armors don't give stats, but instead stats are hidden from players by instead leveling a cosmetic unlocked stat that gives combat stats.

stamina burns too fast builds too slow. come back ever hour to make 5 moves if even that. you have nothing early in game to do, if you are out of stamina other than leave the game. there is no way to get or suprising buy more. you are just done. most of these games give you stuff like crack for the first 30 levels and get you. only reason why this borring game gets 2 stars they are not as greedy as they could be. if you are looking for a once a day 30 to 40 minute tops game, this for you.

ok so if you want something to do for 2-3 hours a day and don't care about playing for competitive reasons this may be the game for you. However... the pay to win gap is huge I'd go as far as to say that the whales are about 120% more strong i was hovering in the top 100 for a while but that's long gone now. Also the game crashes alot during battles in dungeons and out and the initial boot up takes forever ive spent about 15 bucks and I'm at 700k power others are pushing 2mil I have more but...

I really enjoy this game and it's really fun, I also really like the fact there are 0 ads. it's hard to find a mobile game without ads. I personally think there should be more flashy spells/attacks for the staff and sword but primarily the staff because the staff has less flashy moves, but other then that this is an amazing calm game you should definitely try

So many walls in this game. Not enough solid events. To do quests you need feathers and you only get but so many. i spent alot of money in game and it barely gets you anywhere. Huge Money sink this game is just to advance. It was cool at 1st but soon you realize to get anywhere you need to spend 100s if not 1000s of dollars to actually play the game. Gamer Beware the micro transactions in this give you essentially nothing of real value. And you will soon be stuck only to face buying more pacts.

This is actually a really solid game. I'm loving the visual style and the many features the developers put in place. Also, the fact that you can go AFK/Offline and come back to some resources and probably some levels is awesome. I would give the game 5 stars, but I haven't played it for that long yet.

Game is fun when progressing. Eventually you WILL hit a wall and at this point the game becomes not fun. You will have to compete with people that spend $1000s on the game, with no way to win. Content is locked behind character power requirements that everyone is desperately trying to hit due to time limits on seasons. Any gear on the AH that will get you to that power level you wont get because people will spend $100s to outbid you. Game is way too Pay2Win.

Fun game but... to make actual progress you should/need to collect the daily rewards (because you need that power level to go up) which is cool and dope BUT the number of rewards and the different screens to collect in itself is a absolute chore! You can easily spend 5-10 minutes even just collecting you daily rewards for logging in and collecting a reward which unlocks another reward to claim and so forth.. fun game still at its core.

Still very new to this game but it's alot of fun already. It is very easy to see that a lot of work was put into it's development There is always something to do, and progress seems balanced. Characters are also fun, and dialogue is cute. Good job devs! Keep adding content and don't forget about the little guy.

great! early game demands a decent amount of your time, but eases up as you progress to where you can hop on for your dailies, make some good progress, and carry on with your day. i'm worried about the experience for new players, though; seasons are VERY short and focus very heavily on whatever the latest content is, which takes a long time to access at all. some extra attention for those who are still progressing would go a long way for player retention and a growing userbase!

This game likes to throw progress walls and limited time deals in your face constantly. The top players on any given server will be several orders of power higher than anyone else through whaling. Also, the ads I keep getting are what made me come back and put a 1 star review. They range from misleading to outright lying about the game or it's features. Please don't support this game.

Complete lack of content. The game's visuals are pretty. The RPG aspect is railroaded, stray from meta and you're useless. Guilds and social activities are almost non-existent. There's legit 2 things (maybe 15 minutes total, tops) to do every 24 hours, once those are complete you can continuously rerun them for no gain. Was excited about the game at first but the honeymoon period has worn away quite quickly. Would not recommend this game to anyone.

just started, so far, I really enjoy this game. it's built extremely well. Runs smoothly. one thing, I do wish there was an option for Manuel combat. I would like to click my skills sometimes, at least. lol. my only complaint for the moment is the tap and move system. I wish there was an option for freehand. I can never stay with games who don't have this feature long, but I'm hoping that if everything else goes well, I'll keep it. will update soon.

Starts off pretty ok, music is decent and voices are good. But the game is just menus, check lists, paying for power and waiting for exp. You dont really play, you watch the game play itself. Gets old really quick and all there is to do is make number go up. Story is pretty bad and the good voice actors go to waste. If you want an mmo where it contidicts everything a mmo is, then you'll like this.

Mid, require no skill or thoughts whatsoever, just turn off brain and do what it tells you to do. Actual gameplay loop is kinda boring. Not much character progression to be interesting, just unlock skills which you can't manually use. Not my cup of tea. Also, the game takes 3 business days to load. It's a 2D game why does it take so long to load.

While there are definitely aspects of this game I enjoy, it has the same fatal flaw that the other games in this genre have: too much system bloat. There are so many systems and things to manage that I spend 80% of my time playing clicking through menus and screens to collect things rather than exploring the world. Most of the gacha mechanics are pointless and annoying to keep up on. Game would be funner if they cut 95% of it and focused on the world instead of gear and skills.

I seriously love this game. It is definitely worth trying. Visuals, gameplay, and music are all great. However, once you reach the fourth island, progress grinds to a VERY slow climb. In previous areas, you were locked out until you reached a designated power level. On the fourth island, certain areas are 'level locked,' so you just have to wait a day or two until you level up. It turns into a game that you can play for an hour a day before you just have to wait to progress.

Would love to give this a higher rating, but as mentioned by others and the majority of the playerbase that likes the grinding for higher levels, the fact that experience gain is very seldom as well as having minimal ways of acquiring it makes it unappealing as a whole. It's fun up to a point. After around level 65 or so, you get to a point that you have to wait a whole day to even get enough afk exp to push you through to the next level. Ultimately, this will be the game's downfall.

Honestly, overall its a great game. Its not totally pay to win and the grind is actually pretty fun, up till around level 38ish; thats where I have most of my gripes. It goes from using combat power from your gear/spells and such to using your level. I can understand it, with it being an afk game, but after around the previously mentioned levels it gets progressively harder and takes longer to level. That wouldn't be too much of a problem for me if the main way to get XP wasnt being afk.

Customer Service is terrible! I liked the game before there was an issue. My fragments for mythic gear dissappeared. I contacted customer service, which they had me do a self-service inquiry. I sent them all the screen shots. Even if they were to give the frags back, they would be worthless as I am starting on the next set of mythic gear. This game is great, but don't expect customer service if you should get a problem. I regret spending money in this game. I should have just played for free.

Overall, in my opinion, the game is highly enjoyable, offering much for casual, idle gameplay. Perhaps the one thing leaving me a bit miffed is how the level system is required to proceed through specific areas... I mean, we already have these special "gates" that will only let you through based on what your player rank is, and exploring certain areas in general are already calculated through recommended power stats. Why, then, does the level system need to be implemented like that?

The gameplay is enjoyable and the community is nice; however, the game is heavily p2w. There is an Auction House that initially seems like an amazing addition where you buy and sell gear with other players. Unfortunately, you buy with premium currency and when you sell you get the free currency. If they changed this to be all premium it would be far better.

lots of customization with skills, equipment, and load outs but not overly complicated. early game gives plenty of progression materials and items that you feel like you are constantly growing but not completely over powered. I'll probably update my review once I get further in the game, but for now its a good time!

I remember an ad posing a rhetoric to the effect of: "Are you tired of games that feel like you're just going through a daily checklist?" To which my response was: Yes! So I grab the game and give a couple days to impress me. What I like about the game is the cute art style and exploration, story somewhat. However, there are a handful of events going on, like four or five different daily thingies. I spend about 70% of gameplay clicking the word 'claim' just to get it outta of my sight.

every ad has at least 2 moments of false advertising. the game itself is quite fun though, just there are such drastic skill gaps that most of the time, you don't actually end up playing the game. just going afk. just advertise the actual game. the ads make me not want to play it anymore because y'all ain't an honest company. No ads inside the game, it's pretty fun, coming from someone who doesn't usually play games.

I initially gave this 5 stars because I was really enjoying how fast you could gain levels, power, and how much there was to do. But then, at level 30, it slowed waaay down, and once you hit the second island, you couldn't progress until you were at a certain level every single time you opened a new area. The only way to gain EXP is through exploration of these new areas or time. By time, I mean it will take a day to gain enough EXP to go up one or two levels. It's insane and not fun anymore.

While I find the game enjoyable, I believe an adjustment to the experience points awarded for exploration would be beneficial. At higher levels, specifically level 30 and beyond, the current 300 XP gain from exploration becomes negligible and no longer serves as an effective method for character progression. This is particularly relevant given that daily activities can typically be completed within 30 to 45 minutes, suggesting a need for more substantial long-term engagement opportunities.

So much potential, but it seems to be run by morons. Numerous flaws and issues that have so far gone unaddressed. Auction house is a massive bust, no one uses it. Group PvE battles take waaaay too long, yet require you to pay attention to succeed. The "main" currency doesn't have nearly enough uses. Chat at all levels is complete garbage. Several other lesser issues that aren't worth mentioning, since they haven't addressed a single one of the major issues

while the game is solid, almost every single ad is a straight up lie, and basically nothing portrayed in them is actually part of the game, including ai inclusion and integration, the possibility of a player leaving a piece of loot on the ground to insta-kill and break your armor, etc etc. one might argue these aspects not being present is a good thing, and sure... so don't advertise the game as if it includes them. due to deceptive advertising I can't give this game a high rating.

I like the balance of idle, auto battle, and active play. Makes for an interesting experience. But the problem that this game adopts from so many other poorly designed games is the mess of having so many different places to go and collect rewards/gifts/etc. I waste so much more time collecting things from so many different dialogs and not enough time enjoying the gameplay. Plus this is yet another in-game transaction trap.

This game is pretty good! The exploration is amazing and there are great fights you can choose to watch or skip. Only issue is leveling, its very tedious and hard to get through and alot of other players have mentioned that aswell. Also the game has a bug when opening, I have to open it 3 times, the first 2 times it just stays black and on the third it finally opens. Could be an initializing error. Great job dev team, keep it up!

It's a fun, open-world, co-op, idle RPG. It doesn't feel as boring as most other idle games because there is an open world to explore, the idle side of it is done right and only matters when you're away and isn't designed entirely around it. The gacha side of the game is for class skills and you'll be collecting new skills to customize your style of play. It's a unique experience and I have been having fun so far. Servers are very laggy which is my only real problem I have with it.

The art in this game is cute (some AI art pieces in places) and the music is pleasant. But the story, progression, or gameplay isn't that compelling or deep. I imagine that once you start playing with teams it's a little more technical, but maybe not. The game has nailed the "click things and get dopamine" trick, but not much else. If you need a time waster, it's okay and not too demanding of your time or money. But there's better gacha games out there.

Im not a huge spender, maybe $1 or $10 here and there, so I expect to be a lot slower in progression/strength than people willing to spend more money, but the stamina system gets me!! It's a little frustrating that it is 5 stamina/hour. if i want to gather, i have to wait an hour to grab 1 node since they're all 5 stam. i would personally be happy if it were 5 every 30 minutes, so i may play a bit more frequently because the game is fun when i can do stuff (even on idle games :'))

Whale bait. Update: The game dishes out a lot of systems that will wall you if you don't put enough money on it. They gate your progresion with level, power and rank requirements. After some hours you level up, and make it to the next map... for 3 minutes. You clear it up and you wait again. Meanwhile, you have a thousand one bundles, weekly, monthly and daily, welcome gift, top ups, bundles for the one system you unlocked, etc. An event where you only get partial rewards unless... you spend.

Was okay for the first few days, but as of the opening of the third area, it's becoming more apparent that this game is NOT going to be very F2P friendly as time goes on. Multiple systems that nearly lock F2P or later players out of rewards, due to the way matchmaking works. Dungeons and other PvE features start becoming issues if you aren't paying. Otherwise has a ton of P2W mobile game popups, and infinite red dots for rewards to show you just how many things you could be spending on!

Uninstalled within 10 minutes. Intentionally misleading ads to get you to install the game. It's unfortunate because it seems like it might actually be a pretty good game, but I refuse to be lied to in order to give something a chance. Maybe have some pride in your work instead of allowing yourselves to take the easy route and trick people into playing a game that isn't actually what you've represented it to be. "Sorry for your experience, we've passed it along to our team." - The Next Lie

Good graphics. Voice acting is decent. Classes are very boring, early on, without anything unique. Biggest Problem is, areas are blocked by level restrictions, not just difficulty. This forces players to wait, with nothing to do until hours or a day goes by before they can continue playing the dang game, if they've explored everything they can. Really poor choice, stop-gating gameplay...

I can't really play it because it keeps taking me out of the game and glitching badly so I can't even make my character... I'm just going to give up trying to play it on the cellphone and I guess the game, just not made for a cellphone. I really love the characters design and art work where they're fighting and that you can make your own character but I can't get any further than that. but keep making the game better; fun because it looks like a very interesting game I just wish I could play.

This game is still just as cute, and the story as wonderfully crafted, as it was during the Beta. You earn resources and experience while offline, and the battles are automatic, while the exploration is manual. That makes this a slightly different shade of idle RPGs. The characters and the (English) voice actors are what really do it for me though. Masterfully done.

Surprisingly good. If you play too much, there can be a wall for progression - there's no way to farm XP once you've cleared an area. A way to spend stamina on XP would be nice, along with a faster stamina recharge. But the mechanics, maps, story are all really good. I'm having fun, just wish I didn't feel so gated when the next area has a high power level requirement.

decently fun and addicting game, only reason for 3 stars is that they embrace the gacha aspect "literally" and the amount of things they throw at you to buy and the returns for it is quite ridiculous. The season pass is $10 and is only 14 days long, where most other games the season pass atleast last the month. also the higher level you get it feels like you just unlock more ways to spend money. I have been playing for about 3 days and havent hit a wall yet, but feel it coming.

Fun and Free to Play friendly. Only downside: Certain areas require drill/key/potion/power level to unlock and it takes days to save the shop currencies to buy even 1 of those items to continue to explore. Very slow game, you will run out of stuff to do after an hour. Power growth is slow, resources and idle timers are RIDICULOUSLY slow and barely give you anything.

The game is unplayable after passing a certain point. you have 10 minutes of actual gameplay then have to wait for hours to days before you can progress further due to xp gating. You are unable to farm any resources in the meantime that will help with progression. I've supported the game financially and it's disappointing to not be able to play it.

it is a very fun game. Nice when relaxing. The only reason I am giving it a 4 instead of a 5 is because the commercial that lead me to it lied. I thought youd be able to upload your own little image and you get to use a character based on what you uploaded. It is Not set up that way at all. I do hope they add that feature in the future otherwise its falsey advertisement which can get people in trouble. I do like that I can have green skin and that the characters in the story are energetic.

After playing a bit more I'd like to update my review. The game is actually really fun and limits you from wasting time in a great way. The gacha system makes getting skills really easy, but maxing them harder. The resources you need for pulls are pretty abundant and let you pull more often, but you could also pay for more resources. Progression is fun and rewarding. The limit I spoke of is progression locked by power level, level, or rank. Highly recommend. Would love if the pets could roam.

Its a cute game with fun interactions. the game is very straightforward. im basically at a cap where I finish my dailies and need to hit a certain level. everything else is too strong so im literally just waiting for exp to gain passively after 8 hours only to proceed through one section to repeat. other than that, its not bad. theres just very limited ways to get exp

The fact a character or account that cannot transfer to another server is extortion and failure to inform the users initially when they begin or create a character from the initial main menu gives false hope; more so, when the same user purchases in-game items tied to that character; they are unable to move the same account to another server. Therefore, locking (i.e. gated, barred, restricted, unable, prevent, limit, stop, halt, etc.) the account. Verify servers with family and friends.

So as I've played more of the game, it's become more idle and less MMO. Still a pretty fun game and pretty cool, but it really feels weird that reset comes around. you do your dailies and then there's almost no reason to play the game again until the next reset. If you want that that's fine. I want just a little bit more to do here and there throughout the day. Might keep playing, might stop.

undeniably my favorite game on mobile, which is a feat. only problem I have is that if you invite your friends and wanna help them grow but the server your in happens to be full you just can't, which is disappointing. I don't know if there will ever be solution to that or even have any real light shed on that but it would be great to play with friends without having to restart on a dif server with em. maybe it could be possible to migrate full chars to servers instead of a restart! awesome game!

I'll be honest, being in a day 1 server sucks. With the introduction of the Nexus Server, and its limitation, it makes it hard to play with friends. Especially since day 1 servers are all full and none of my friends can join me, and my only option is to restart from the beginning and lose ALL progress I made and any items I paid for. Other than that issue, the game is fun outside of the constant waiting for xp cause a zone requires a specific level and then the next zone requires another

Whoever they outsourced the online ads to deserves to be kicked in the pants. Other than that, the real game itself is the fun kind of mindless level grind generator, and is shockingly good for a game with no real story at all. Sometimes all you need to look at on your phone is Anime Girl and Funny Number Go Up. While the misleading ads are a letdown, I am quite alright with a cozy JRPG that doesn't take up too much space.

Great game! Don't let the "ads" reviews discourage you. I didn't see any ads and downloaded this game to try it and I'm glad i did. It has a very good balance of leveling vs being able to complete game content and has kept me very entertained. There's a lot of exploration, challenges mini puzzles, etc. It's not 3D but the graphics are cute and charming. I can understand if you're upset about ads but overall it's a fun game

fun game, free yes, if you wanna take a nice slow route and don't care about rankings, outbiding others, etc. personal experience someone posted a sword worth $10 in the "auction house" I put a bid on it. I had spent enough to get the credits 1000 lumium) someone out-bidded and then bragged about how he could buy a car with his money instead wastes an extra (600 luminum) taking it to $16 (player has spent over $150 for special cosmetic gear) so expect that but thats about normal for mobile now!

the game itself is fine. however, every single ad for the game is deceptive or a flat out lie. there's no random anything, there's no regions to choose from, there's no ai-powered story. it's not even barely an idle game. and most ads made for use AI so they're even more deceptive in that case because they don't even show real footage of the game. there's no animated login screen that shows different regions. one add showed someone using a keyboard and mouse which isn't possible. deceptive game.

lots of fun. It feels surprisingly new and refreshing, so far ive played several hours and have not spent a penny and it has not hindered my ability to play the game at all. only thing I dont care for, and this is more device specific, but the game needs better widescreen support for foldable phones. If youre in the main menu, it looks good and fills the whole screen, but for some reason when you go out into the world, the resolution goes down a bit and theres black bars. needs fixed.

A fun PvE time-spender RPG. It's refreshing not to be blinded by special offers in a game. They exist but the game has never pushed anything at me, nor do I feel the need to buy anything unless I want to support the game. There eventually is a wall to hit in terms of daily progression but honestly, it's nice. I play a bit then log out until later that day or the next. Graphics are fun, combat is auto but has puzzle-like strategy to choosing skills used in succession, and easy to understand.

been playing for maybe a month and I love this game. you don't have to pay to win and the grind doesn't feel overwhelming. your power grows fast and there's always something for you when you log in. between the events going on and the quests I feel like they are handing away loot by the fist full and it's amazing.

Go! Go! Muffin without the micro, but with PVP. The rating is critical, but I cant give it a higher rating if I won't continue playing. Issues for me would be language dubbing(ENG only) and the story lacking a lot of depth. The different systems, visuals, and monetization all seem well executed. If their Konosuba collab was instead their core theme with other universes/IPs being mixed in, I'd easily be more invested in the game. Best of luck.

The glaring issue is mage/sage/sorcerer reigns supreme vs warrior class, in all aspects. Buff the melee class or every server will be the caster class. 90% of every player I see is a caster. And if you enjoy spending an hour chasing all the red "click me's", this is a home run. I spend a half hour clicking on all the useless rewards that equate to nothing, but a time sink.

Cute avatars and world design. I like exploring the map and how easy it is to team up for boss fights. The story is okay, but some of the voices have awkward inconsistent accents. My biggest problem is the skill cool down system. New battles should start with all skills ready to activate, instead they continue wherever you left off in your last battle. I had to sit through a team dungeon where I couldn't attack because my skill cool down kept resetting to wait one turn at the start of each room.

honestly a fun game, no annoying pop-up ads (that I've seen) a lot of options to get free rewards and a cute artstyle also for the first time I've ever seen, a mobile game has a not half baked story and this one is pretty good so far, (quick ad here but consider joining my guild umbra-solis its set to auto accept and has no criteria for joining so new guys like me and vets can join if they want :D)

This game is incredibly fun at first, which is why I'm so sad to write this review. I've spent 93 hours playing, got my IRL family into it, and now I have to give up. The devs have NO long term plan and everything past the first island is heavily gated behind days of AFK and paywalled strength checks. Everything is geared to whales/purchases only. People drop 3k+ and still get screwed over. I loved this game but the greed ruined it. There's no fun left.

It's an incredibly 2-dimensional game. The combat isn't very exciting, and the progression isn't satisfying. Too many things are gated behind higher EXP levels for seemingly no reason. It's really a game of, hunt the red notification dots, of which there are far too many and hidden within deeply layered menus.

this game is just dumb. level gates on progress, power gates on progress, item gates on progress. you basically can play once a day if that, and know eventually you will maybe only be able to play a couple times a week. game runs on FOMO and constantly dying servers cause eventually this type of game becomes unplayable. nothing you buy is worth anything since the servers always collapse. The game shows how dead it is by a % on the map which is hilarious.

Fun and strategic, gacha mechanics don't feel egregious, community is good and helpful in my experience. End game is fashion and friends really. Couple things I think they could improve: Queue preferences. If I get randomly queued with 3 other paladins the run is shot from the start. Ways to fine tune stats on equipment. It's more important to have bigger gear score than the right stats now but it would be nice to directly tune or have more opportunities to tune equipment to specific builds

Sword and Staff is an Idle RPG unlike any other. There are in-app purchases, but you don't need to spend money in this game to have fun or to be competitive. I'm the top of my server and I have spent exactly $0 on this game. There are bountiful rewards, missions, and events to keep you "topped up". The storytelling is great, and the voice lines are hilarious! I've read several reviews that mention the Level "XP blocking", but just complete missions, take on dungeons, and you'll level up quickly.

It's a nice chill game with lots of social aspects to it that makes worth playing together with friends! However there are many power/level blocks that make it impossible for someone new to catch up to older players. There is also WAY TOO MUCH microtransactions!!! Forever shoved in your face for every little resource possible. And no way to obtain all event rewards without spending cash. It's addicting but so unfriendly to f2p players.

It's a very fun and well thought out game to play when you just want some down time and it's fun to grind your levels and have fun with friends alike. you can really customize your character and go on a fun little adventure. the graphics are great in this chibi style game. I recommend this game for anyone who just wants a fun game to just relax and have time down time with.

I don't often leave reviews and it usually takes a game being utterly horrendous or masterfully crafted to warrant me doing so. This game is an excellent example of the latter. A truly excellent game, a beautifully crafted world, interesting lore, and fantastic voice acting (rare for a mobile game), also no intrusive ads! The gameplay is fun and just engaging enough to keep me interested without becoming tedious, and it boasts a unique style of gameplay as well. I look forward to future updates.

unplayable, false data storage requirements, laggy, multiple game crashes with no other apps running in the background, just a waste of time and data, before uninstall app info says it took up 2.5 gigabytes, not 600 megabytes. didn't even get to play the game, crashes happened in the menu, can't even imagine what playing the game would do to my device, better not to risk it.

I really like this game its very good It doest take alot of storage, Note that you can Afk farm so you dont have to waste hours of grind you can just leave the game and earn exp like that. It's very Fun But I do what to add is That you can get more unique skill class and Armour and weapons because there's a chance someone might look exactly like you so you can change even more of the the way you look. I also want to say to add titles to the game it will look cool to see a someone title Is Admin.

Cute game, lots to do, and pretty intuitive. Its a fun mmo/sandbox/afk/questing, all in one. -Edit: After having played a while, the game absolutely has diminishing .. everything.. diminishing drops, diminishing returns, etc.. I've gone[as of today's review] 108 dungeon attempts without a single piece of dungeon gear drop.. not even that it dropped but wasn't my class, it just doesn't drop. [thats 27 days, out of 35 days on the server]. The game is rigged, or absolutely poor designed RnG.

I played it for 6 hours & got too level 21 or so. the game wasn't making me happy or excited to play it. the game needs more skills. the 200+ skills isn't real. maybe in a update; but it's not now. the ad was fake too. all the fighters played the same & all the mages. played the same. everyone had the some abilities. the deep customize was a lie. they should've added more skills

I waited a bit to review this. They waited to introduce the power level gate until the 2nd area, and it's a massive gap. Edited for more info: waiting days to progress one stage isn't fun. And the power gaps only get bigger. There's not much to do if you're waiting. Gear upgrades are RNG in dungeons and for idle rewards. It could be a week before you get something better.

As far as idle games go, this one does the basics well. just enough content unlocks each day to keep you engaged. Pacing is set by time gating, with a quick falloff in ROI for paying players. Skills and classing are very cool, but currently class progression is extremely linear. I would love to see more class options as the game evolves.

Excellent game but crashes often. Thankfully a lot of it will run on their servers so it's not like you have to start the same fight over and over. it completes by the time you log back in and you get the results. still very annoying considering how simple the graphics are. I have no idea how you're making my phone hot in menus. The good? Great skill system, lot of fun builds, and a pretty steady drip of unlocks and upgrades so you only start to slow down by the second area. Get some stability.

The SpongeBob reference and the ad itself where the player is frustrated about playing as a Goblin really, is a good way to draw players to this game. I also, like how the player acts all surprised by girls attacking him in the game! Honestly, first impression not too bad did it make me laugh? No, but it did make me want to give a try and see if it's worth the time investment. And on a Samsung Galaxy A13 phone it takes 6 minutes to install and the performance is amazing! But that's said for all.

Love the game. Play it everyday. Great experience. Other players are 99% friendly. Smooth progression. Love the graphic design. I do have 2 suggestions/wants for the game though. 1) We need more ways to acquire the Drills, Acid, and Keys for the locked rooms. Maybe a chance as loot drops. 2) I'd LOVE to see a Trade/Gift mechanic between Guild Members. Personally, I'm not gonna spend real money for Luminium to acquire items on the Auction House.

This take handles power creep well, paces the game without energy restriction or much use of timers. Super fun, lots of teaming up with others. Not pay to win, can you get an advantage? Sure but not enough that makes a huge difference. The best part? NO ADS!!!! Like seriously no ads, optional or forced. I can't remember the least game I could enjoy non stop without ads, a breath of fresh air.

Its a solid...meh. Generic idle progress, gated content, generic skills and an annoying "guide" character. The one and only thing that is interesting is how combat is handled. Its interesting, but not great. Just a meh. Play it a few hours, get your fun from it, uninstall it and move to the next game that has some actual content.

The gameplay is pretty good. I have two issues. xp progression and summon builds. Zones are locked by level, level is locked by xp, xp is locked by zones. this means days of idling. Summoner builds are awful, the summon respawn doesn't coulddown fast enough, they do maybe 2/3 damage of any other build. Sometimes doing less than a debuffing build. I have to find someone 200k power under me to win in arena with summons and half the exploration can't be done with them at the correct level.

They added a way to look up servers but then now people still can't get into play with friends and family because the server will not let them make a character because of capacity issues it's one thing after another when trying to recommend this game but other than that it isn't bad the English Voice Acting is cool and it is pretty off head.

amazing game , truly a work of art . can't wait to see what expansions and update ideas you guys put together ... so now I am 48k power I spent my stuff wisely too . I am at a dead point I can't progress any further and there is nothing I can do in the game to pass the time or to even help my self level . it really sucks when games are like this . I want to keep playing but I can't . maybe keep in mind to have things in the game to make it continually playable . I guess I gotta wait =(

it's wonderfully made. the combat is fun to watch, the management tasks are fun. you really feel for a while that you're getting more and more powerful. at least, for the first couple days. then you're suddenly no longer getting better gear, not gaining levels often, and too low powered for all the new areas, no one to match with for needed dungeons (seems the population wave for new game has already faded), and event changes means u no longer get same rewards as other players got last week.

it's a cute, grindy MMO RPG. i immediately unlocked a cat shaped burger on a fork for my weapon and it was awesome. no real complaints but all of the battling is auto battle. i prefer games where skill is required to win, but this one is done better than most auto battlers. some thought is put into build, st least. I dont care for games where you just win every time you do nothing and collect 400 items from 25 places every few hours.

I feel like a lot was promised but not a lot was delivered. the game had a great ad campaign, but failed to deliver on it. there's little to nothing strategy, really just put your best and strongest put or follow elemental weakness, that's it. no control over the fights leaves some fights highly possible to win but you cant because its pure luck if you character will do the best thing or not. also there are A LOT of power/level/item walls. its very aggravating and is going to be end for the game

Decent AFK and rpg elements, but with a really gross pay for power element. You won't see it till your far in the game, but once the airship auction house is unlocked lvl 40 you'll see it. Buying character power is already pretty gross, but here you have to buy currency and bid against other players to get the best equipment. One of the grosser monetization mechanics ive seen, even by gatcha standards.

game quality is 5 star. but the auction system is a total scam. requires real money to buy (that's fine) but then they convert every purchase to a unusable on the market currency. meaning every purchase from a player is actually from the company for real money, no cycling of funds. absolute greed garbage that will just flat out ruin any chance of a function auction market. that's too bad too because it has a lot of potential for players to stack farm gear and be able to get good income from it.

It's an awesome game. The biggest downside, in my opinion, is the time-locked upgrade(referring to rank ups) it's a nearly 2 day (48 hours) of a wait time to be able to rank to elite 1. Which is only the 4th rank, which getting to rank 3 is quick! if you for a few hours worth of time a day you can reach or be just shy of rank 3 in no time. Would be 5* if that wasn't a thing, OR it was cut waaay down, to like 6 or even 8 hours. More activities and charges for said activities would be nice.

Very engaging, beautiful art style, and overall a great phone game. You actually play the game it's not just a click to get bigger numbers, with a voiced story to dive in. The best part is gearing/power scaling is simple enough not to be overwhelming but still allowing so much complexity and customization; as far I have seen one load out isn't king, different ability combinations work better in some situations. I will say though it does have "pay to win" mechanics.

Done very well among games in similar style. only thing I could say from being apart of others like this is developers, please add more things to do in free time like mining for materials. could change it uo to were you use stamina for bigger chunks but once stamina is over you could only get maybe 5% of what you could get with stamina. so there's less waiting and you cana actively make constant progress. better systems for the commissions would be great to.

Pretty amazing game, I love the look and feel, combat/strategy is very satisfying. only thing that has bothered me is trying to play the game leaning into a tank archetype. I love playing hard to kill and like using skills that buff me up, but things like round timer dont let me outlast enemies (mostly for solo) but on the flipside I LOVE the taunts and team helping stuff. Keep up the good work devs!

Game is great overall, grinding can take time but I play games that require a lot more. Biggest issue I'm currently having is people aren't paying attention frequently for the party up sections of the game. Way too common currently that people run out the timers or don't select paths for daily dungeon making things take a lot longer. Personally think there should be some form of timer placed on people doing this preventing them from joining for a set time, if they're running timers out.

Update day 4: Game is amazing but my biggest complaint is that you hit points where you have nothing left to do. I had to wait a day to get to elite then i got to 3rd island just to get stuck again. It seems at points your forced to go AFK or "pay to advance" ...Still a great game but find myself just going elsewhere after i hit my ceiling. Give players content to stay and not just having to pay tons of money to advance. I budget about 30 to 50 a month.

So I know this game has only been out a couple days but I LOVE IT!!!!!! It is extremely polished and runs excellently on my less than stellar phone (only had one crash in about 6-8 hrs of playtime). I love the art and character design and the fully voice acted cutscenes was SUCH a pleasant surprise. The gameplay is very refreshing. As opposed to many other games in this genre you only are upgrading one character. And speaking of which the main character sprite is just adorable!!!!!

The game isn't bad and is relatively user friendly but progression is rather slow because leveling and grinding for gear takes quite a bit of time. As someone who is f2p it kinda sucks just having to wait out the day because I literally cannot farm for anymore gear, upgrade resources, or get xp fast at all. The game is fun besides this aspect as much as I love idle games I don't like doing literally nothing personally. Now if you don't have much time to play this game is for you.

Hi! I just wanted to let everyone know that I definitely satisfy with my experience in this game. Seriously though, this is a decent game. Character progression is satisfying. Strategy is in playable character build and can be as deep as you want it to be (or not). You will see ads for upgrade packs and event packs. . . all the packs. Be careful and don't let your competitive nature get you to spend more than you can afford. Fully voice acted. Good art. Gacha is for PC skills, not waifus(!).

The game is really well made. not a bunch of bad bugs. And it's a good idea for a game. But it's plainly obvious this is only going to provide maybe 30 minutes of enjoyment per day if you're lucky. resources come extremely slow. And after 24 hours you will hit a grind wall that makes you log out and hope you get enough AFK rewards over the next day to do one or two upgrades. The stamina system is a complete joke. completely outdated in these types of games. and no option to refill quickly.

Sword x Staff surprised me a little. I expected another generic mobile RPG cash grab, but it feels way more polished and relaxed than most games in this genre. The biggest thing I like is that it doesn’t feel super stressful to keep up with. You can kinda just explore, build your character how you want, and let the game progress even when you’re offline. The combat is auto-battle, but there’s enough customization and skill combinations that it still feels satisfying instead of mindless.

The game is it based around playing with others and the only thing it promotes is its own game! NO ADDS whatsoever! Leveling up is time based and its very friendly if you want to Progress without spending a dime. There's just about an infinite amount ways you can build your character being it a DPS, Tank, Healer, debuffer ect. There are a couple downsides but the most noticeable one is playtime, getting things done is very quick and you run out of things to do in about an hr till the next day.

I have no idea who is in charge of your advertising, I have seen this game pitched as a "full AI" game (which it isnt), a 3d MMORPG akin to honkai 3rd or monster hunter wilds(which it isnt), and have a drag and drop a picture funtion to make your avatar(which again it doesnt). This game is more akin to AFK Journey but with vector puppet rigs instead, which is not a bad thing to be compared to. please dont advertise your alpha sales pitches that do not reflect your final product.

game can be fun, but whoever designed the exp system is really making is miserable. I explore 1 area now and have to wait to get exp because you get it from your bed at your base. next area requires you to level up by 2 every time!!!! you barely get to play. it is almost becoming unplayable at this point.

The game is pretty cool and adorable. a couple of things so far- When dismantling the gear, it would be nice to have a bulk select option. Also, I would love to see more outfit options with the outfits and gear, that you don't have to spend real money to earn.

Game has great potential. Love the story and most of the gameplay. Could definitely use more to do in the early game as I finished as far as I can for yet another day and have nothing to do in game. A mini game or some kind of even mmo pvp to earn stamina could be useful to give us something to do. Could use more character outfits. Guild warehouse is disappointingly small.

I give this a 4.5, its fun game I can play whenever I want and grind. Good combat System, great visuals, UI and a lot of variety. It's 4.5 and not a 5. It describes itself as a 3 way, idle/afk JRPG but I feel like it leans into that a bit too much. I think it's kinda leaned into the p2w side since some parts I physically cannot progress unless I afk for a few hours. I spent some money. Grinding would feel better without the stamina system and if the dungeon raids didn't have the reward limit.

The game is decent, but you will likely feel overwhelmed. There is a lot of useless menu navigation to find all the missions or quests that are completed and needs to be redeemed. The quality of the game is good, systems work, players have agency on how to approach the game, the combat and puzzles are satisfying. If you enjoy gachas I suggest you try it.

the game is kind of fun, but expect to wait alot. progression is dependent on level which can only be increased with the afk xp accumulated in the bed. and if you stay on top of it and level up too fast, there's an actual countdown preventing you from increasing the cap. Whales don't necessarily progress much faster but the game difficulty becomes trivial to them. If you decide to spend money, avoid buying gear at the auction house. that gear will be obsolete in a few days with the new area.

this game is AMAZING. one of the best mobile games, comparable to even steam games! only one problem. you DESPERATELY need to replace whoever's in charge of advertising. in one of the ads, they advertise using AI to generate your avatar or equip certain skills as a main part of it, and many people certainly do not like AI. if they were to see that ad, they may get a bad impression of the game and miss out on playing the wonder that is sword x staff.

I think it's a really cute game! I haven't been playing long, but the voices are amazing, the art is beautiful! and! AND! THE MOST IMPORTANT THING OK: there is absolutely NO ADS! ✨🎉 that is special! this is the only game ever I've ever played with absolutely no ads! and there is a very nice community and a chat feature! it's all together very nice :)

I think the game is good and perfect for me so far, unique and have integrated the afk feature very well. It's a unique game, people who have too much time on their hands will complain. We just need to learn to play the game and enjoy it. I think the developers will improve things as time goes . Update: A little bit more continuously playable content will be good because the it's like 80-90% of the time have to afk.

Good game but there are some problems, I have nothing to criticize about the story and VFX, but the loading time is horrendously long even with a decent device. The sword classes are very weak because of the lack of AoE & damage at the start - mid part of the game compared to the mage classes. Some resources that are essential like Refined Ores are boring or hard to get depending on the player's level. You should also add an efficient way to get EXP besides AFKing and side/main story quests.✌️

Super fun with lots of playstyles and great teamwork. No ads, which is a huge plus! That said, the app has long loading times and frequent disconnects that desync the audio. P2W players are always twice as strong, while auctions offer little value for F2P players. Story progression is locked to solo mode and slows down considerably. The report system also seems ineffective, even after repeated offenses and multiple reports by many.

Gotta say, this game had me hooked at first, but the fun only lasts for a few days. As you level up, the rewards get worse and progression slows down a lot. I'm only in World 2 and already hitting a wall where it feels like spending money is the only way to keep moving through PvE content. On top of that, whales completely dominate PvP, guild events, and anything that gives an advantage to paying players. Free-to-play players just can't realistically compete.

Love the game, just a little thought: when there is maintenance it would be better to have "maintenance" (best including expected duration) showing. Currently I just get an endless loading screen, so I don't know if my game broke or there is maintenance (I don't memorize the notices beforehand). When I was new I almost dropped the game because I thought it was broken - and it still makes me somewhat insecure :) much love and thanks for the game :)

The animation and art style is good and some of the events are fun. The grind eventually becomes exhausting. They hard lock content and force you to wait. The game is heavily paid to win. You will feel behind, and the match making is horrendous. I did spend quite a bit, but eventually the game is just a repetitive 20 minute daily content and you'll fall behind. After some terrible failed match making for dungeons, I decided to uninstall it.

I had to change my review, the amount of packages to buy is simply absurd, and the prices are insane. There are some cosmetics that costs more than $1000, not to mention the fact of you having to spend weeks to unlock a part of the map that you will walk and finish in 10 seconds. The item acquisition makes no sense also, there are supposed to be lvls on the item but it actually doesn't have. game with amazing potential but some weird design I like it, but still....

everything with the game so far is enjoyable amd does not feel like a chore. However, a weird issue has appeared that has left me extremely frustrated. In Aqualis, after fighting the boss on the island something weird happened either a misclick or something. I ended up back on the mainland and there is no teleporter to go back there to get the items dropped from the fight or the statue buff. its left frustrated enough to drop the game as I see no way to get back there to claim the items.

The most annoying thing is that there are a butt load of red dot for a butt load of packs while you get ounces of currencies there to remove notifications. The game itself is so basic and all about leveling up with different skill set. There are tons of things to do at the beginning but eventually everything gets time/level gated. so you wait if you don't pay. anyway if you like idle leveling where the game will play itself while you make growth decisions you might like.

When I first downloaded this, I stopped because I wasn't going to do the initial 1 GB installation for an idle game. I decided to give it an honest go after seeing some more ads, let it download... This is not an idle game, it's even better; it's basically a full RPG that rewards you with exp and materials every second of the day and I love it. I've never seen a game with such a respectful chat, I love how easy it is to make a team, basically every action is rewarded, and the events! That's all

The game will overwhelm players with a million things to click, and repeated clicking as quotas are met. After a day or two of this, the "game" slows down, as the real imbalance shows: this plays like an adventure, but expects players to suffer all the waiting of an idle! I found myself frustrated that I couldn't power through as I had been, because going up a class tier or several levels suddenly meant having to wait until the next day. Wasted potential, I'm sure many casuals will leave.

Great ideas and I really do see what this game is going for so its very passable all thing considered. I like the design I like how the characters move, there voices are thankfully not annoying, but I would say I would've liked to have more autonomy in like moving and attacking while in battle than the presetup stuff you do for your attacks they have you do instead. Not overly difficult nor overly easy. And I've had 0 bugs related from the game yet. I am only at level 21 to be clear

first time I ever wrote a review, so I bought a pack in the game and then when I finished paying for it and I saw the money being taken from my bank account. The game didn't register it as payment succesful, that is quite unfortunate and I personally think that is an issue that should be addressed Edit: so after around 3 hours later, the issue was fixed. besides that one mishap, I genuinely like and enjoy the game.

It's so cute. It's not those 'idle afk games' where you basically don't need to click anything and your character lvl up automatically. Auto mode is absolutely optional just to skip fights but not to do whole exploration for you. You actually need to stay in game and do something to lvl up and to power build. Love that we also can cutomize our character, but I wish we could add more "traits" like ears AND horns instead of this or this. Like up to add max 3 traits would be cool :)

here are things I think would make the game better: adding more options to GUI colors/textures. making it possible to zoom out more when you're exploring because it's annoying to keep dragging my finger across the screen every few steps. adding more spells (I'm currently on 9% of the third area so idk if you're not supposed to get more spells until after). adding a way to farm exp because it gets boring when the only way to get more exp when you've explored all you could is to just afk all day.

The game is fun. but the art looks like it was made by using generative AI which makes me want to stop playing as a level 36. I really want to keep supporting and playing but the ads are so misleading and support the use of AI which sucks. I don't actually know if it uses AI, but by the looks of it, it does. Nobody wants to play a game using AI illustrations, hire a real artist! And the ads are simply terrible. Otherwise that the game itself is fun but very very slow... you get stuck alot.

When I downloaded this game, I thought it was gonna be a scam, but it was actually a very fun and enjoyable game, it has little details that I like so much. There's even an option to talk with other players online where you can use other in-game emojis too and a way to translate other languages. Only thing really to fix is that you can defeat a group of enemies slightly stronger than you. Definetly deserves the 4.7 star rating.

fixed my technical issues by resetting my phone. unfortunately my progress has been lost due to being a guest. Other than this hiccup the game is a lot of fun, I'm not one to trust mobile games, especially ones I saw in an ad, but this one's pretty fun, saw a YouTube I know playing it and gave it a spin. it's both in-depth and hands-off in a way that respects your time. it's addictive in the whole power grindy/hording way. and it's very f2p friendly.

It's a fun game - looks good, plays well, but... typical mobile game, hit a progression wall after a day or two and then either pay or wait while your strength crawls up slowly. Zone strength requirements start jumping in larger increments to slow you down as well. Paywall isn't forced on you, and the biggest issue is that purchases feel expensive for what you get, and the resources won't even do much or last that long. Standard mobile greed. If it felt better value, I'd happily pay to support.

Great game so far. alot, but they have good quick tutorials, and cheap under dollar stuff. like it so far. edit: actually just one thing I would like to add if possible. in the map, I can't really squeeze or squish it really well. could you add that so I can see the whole map better? otherwise it's a little pain to scroll around while zoomed in. thanks!

So far i have loved this game. the art style is amazing and the characters are very lively. however i hate the combat. i feel like its not nearly interactive enough to be worth even having in the game. it feels like its just a boring unskippable cutscene. if you had to control where your characters move and attacked it would have been fine. but you just can't. it makes the game so much worse. if the combat was more interactive then this game would be an easy five star

very promising game, no ads and no forcefeeding pay2win pop ups through your throat, very much recommend this game, the only downside is the stamina and how fast its restoring, basically halting some progress with the shop to buy certain things to unlock map stuff. Not that it matters much, but thats what the 4 stars are for. so refreshing to finally not have an aggresive money game. overall pretty good game :)

Very very good game. I'm writing this a bit later. This is the ONLY game I've ever spent on real money on to get stuff. It's very cosy, I love the art style and the customization, and nothing is over-priced. (Though, there are a few expensive things you could buy) I hope that it continues this way. I haven't found any issues other than a bit of lag when clearing dungeons/joining teams/playing with other people in general. I couldn't recommend you try it enough.

Love the game! Normally I hate these types of games but this one I haven't stopped playing. I'll admit I'm addicted to it and will never stop playing as long as I am alive. Keep improving it and making it amazing can't wait for more updates! I've run into a bit of a problem. I'm not sure if other Sage's have experienced this but when I have the revive charm equipped and I go into a dungeon and crucible with a team of adventurers, if one goes down it should revive them, but doesn't. Is it a bug?

I think I'd like it more if there was an option to control combat manually instead. It'd just be a simple turn based system where I get to control my actions and targets in a turn but that would greatly elevate the experience for me. I like having control. Even if it's just as simple as picking targets/directions for my skills that'd be enough

The game would be solid 4 stars, I love the voice acting, but the ads... All the ads I saw were showing a game that was not this one, so none of them were actually showing the real game. I'm not even talking about missing gameplay footage. There is gameplay and stills of menus used in advertising footage that are not part of this game. This is only legally okay because the game is free to play.

The game is honestly quite fun. I can't believe I stayed up till 5 in the morning, grinding for everything that I could within the first day. I'm not one for giving reviews, but the games pacing is quite interesting. I love how they don't force micro transactions down your throat after closing every other menu. The gacha system for skills is quite lenient, and they give you quite a bit of special currency just for exploring. Quite a fun game and am glad for being there for release.

I'm now level 10. the game haves great smooth animations. rewards are great keeping me playing. Edit (level 40): trading system is with premium currency, so it is obligating to pay with real money to be able to use it. This is really disatisfying and disappointing. I sugest as a solution for everyone that publishing in the trading system haves no fee (it is unnecesary), and ftp players can gain the premium currency by trading. This is not blocking the gains, on contrary, it will make it bigger

Beautiful looking game, was just starting to enjoy it, made a small purchase that failed to materialise. Dutifully raised a query with their "help centre". Several hours went by, they responded, when I was not near my phone. after LESS THAN FIVE HOURS they closed the ticket instead of leaving the ticket open for me to respond in a REASONABLE timeframe. Went back in, now shoved in some queue without the ability to properly relay my issue. if you want to play, don't bother with purchases.

I used to really enjoy the game but one day all of my progress was deleted and I was told that was because the game has finally had its full release. I would not have put as much time as I did into the game if I knew that this was going to happen, I guess it was fun while it lasted but they might erase your progress in the future I don't know so watch out for that I guess.

Fantastic game with one horrible feature that ruins it. Stamina... you get 5 per hour and can only buy 35 a day. It takes 5 to harvest or kill anything. So when you clear an area it cost 5 stamina per action... Pregression is really unbalanced. Ive come to a complete halt 3 times now and im not even high lvl. When youve got everything cleared up to the next area but youre still too low to do it... theres literally nothing you can do. It needs to be 100 stamina 3x a day from the shop, at minimum

Ohhh boy where to begin. Been playing for a month, first week was great all around but if you dont start spending money on this game you will be left behind fast. Just another quick cash grab game and push out most of the player base. Paywalls are everywhere for every little thing. Finding players now triple my combat power. The story levels are now harder to complete without paying into the game. F2P is not an option in this game unless you like to struggle the whole time.

P2W and unbalanced. Certain builds, like summon and healing sage, are useless. Damage and money is the only thing that matters. Time sensitive weekly events make it terrible to try to participate from a different time zone. Dungeon balance progression is so flawed that you need whales to carry endgame. Auction House incentivises p2w since you can buy permanent stat foods, better gear with real money, etc. The amount of different battle passes and pricing is also incredibly predatory. Stay away.

after a month, the game feels more like a chore than a game. I log in, do my dailys, I log out. the game isn't very interactive other than starting a task or acknowledging some sort of prompt. event puzzles are fun sometimes and the soccer mini game was cool. if you like mindless grind of doing chores, this game is for you. if you want to be involved and interact with combat, look else where. one of my bigger gripes is not allowing 'offline friends' do daily dungeons. why?

I've seen this game advertised for some time now, and it had peaked my interest. So I gave it a shot. normally these types of games don't hold interest to me because: 1. Energy base 2. microtransaction 3. UI 4. in-game ads. surprisingly for me, no in-game ads. UI is good and not an eyesore to navigate. microtransaction is a turn off for me but wouldnt stop me from playing. the energy system i highly dislike because it gatekeeps me from playing the game as I start to enjoy it. overall it's good.

unfortunately I need to edit my review. The game is so much fun until you reach about level 25-27. I've discussed it with other players as well. you hit a wall and can't explore or do anything worthwhile until you wait on passive exp or buy things from the various shops. I think it's still something I want to play, but I'm very disappointed now.

This game was fun... until it wasn't. Essentially once you reach Aqualis you will hit a wall where you need to reach t3 or p2w to stand a chance in the dungeon. But you must wait a week to unlock t3. There isn't any skill variety like it tries to boast. You run the meta or lose. There just isn't enough resources to go around, my skills and gear are both behind. There are areas locked behind keys & stuff that take forever to get. Unless you are a whale, I don't recommend this.

One of the best games to come out recently. Fun gameplay, interesting characters, progression is decent even without paying if you don't really want to. My only gripe is, as others have said, you can't play or migrate your character to another server if you have a friend that plays on it.

It's not awful, but it is boring. In my opinion, anyway. I'm aware it has the idle features for a reason, but it feels like it isn't even me playing the game, just the auto feature. All I have to do is adjust artifact stuff, collect flowers and ores, and thats all. It isn't bad, but not good in my opinion either. When I had this game, I'd get bored in 15 minutes because the gameplay is boring. It isn't even you doing it.

this game is fun but I feel like we are to restricted. 1. Having companions and parties makes almost literal no sense since it is limited to what you can do.. you can only have them pretty much follow you around only in COMPLETED areas. make them playable in the unexplored areas and other instances. 2. Make a way to farm exp while you're capped out. I was walled off at 23 having to wait literal hours just to play another 10 mins. There is so much more but I have limited text. 6/10 game.

Cute, and enjoyed messing around with the ability synergy for a bit, but honestly it's really repetitive and the monotony only gets broken up by an ounce of story every once in a while. Probably realistically like 5% of the gameplay is story. Mostly it's just waiting for someone stronger than you to pull you through repetitive daily content to work towards gear + spending daily stuff on everything else, including the ability and pet gacha. Gets boring fast and dailies take too long imo

Gameplay is alright. Felt like I had to spend 10 minutes clocking through different monetization screens to collect free rewards constantly instead of actually playing. Lost interest in the game completely once I saw some ads for the game showing 3D "gameplay". This game is fully 2D, so those ads are completely misleading. It's a shame, because the game isn't even bad, so why the false advertisement?

Don't bother unless you want to spend lots of money to progress. Tried the game. It's casual and enjoyable but too many bots. They'll start with asking to be friends and that they also just started the game. Then tell you their age and where they are from. I've only been playing a few hours but I think I'll be playing a lot more of it

Fun game, good concept, good customization, BUT it gets boring very fast. You very quickly hit a wall in progression. Stopped playing and uninstalled after a few days and according to the system progression I was farther than 79% of the other players. No idea how accurate that is if at all but I found myself walking around, very slowly increasing my strength to get access to a single area just to get a single item to destroy a block to continue. In the end its just not for me.
